changelog: Support for ESX Legacy and QBCore, including multicharacter servers.
Configurable VIP plans with duration, salary, coins, welcome benefits, and additional inventory weight.
Secure package queue for online and offline Tebex purchases, manual claims, and chargebacks.
Package rewards supporting money, accounts, coins, items, vehicles, and properties.
Free or Tebex-purchased Daily Rewards with permanent or monthly access and personal or calendar-month progression.
Monthly Battle Pass with free and Premium tracks, XP, levels, daily and weekly missions, and automatic resets.
Built-in missions for logins, playtime, and distance driven, with support for custom missions.
Mansion and penthouse system with ownership, stashes, outfits, door locks, and configurable garages.
Custom NUI menu with a complete ox_lib menu alternative.
Administration menu, management commands, and configurable Discord logs.
Editable integrations for target, door locks, appearance, garages, and vehicle keys.
Automatic creation of all required database tables and columns.
Server-side validation, atomic claims, and protection against duplicate redemptions and malicious event calls.
Installation diagnostics and documentation for configuration, integrations, and custom mission creation.
